newsitem.title: RUSSIA: City of Moscow expects syndicated credit soon.
newsitem.headline: City of Moscow expects syndicated credit soon.

text.p: The City of Moscow is working on receiving a credit from a syndicate of Western banks, which is likely to be signed in the near future, sources in the city government said on Monday.
The consortium is led by Societe Generale of France, Deutsche Morgan Grenfell and West Merchant Bank, they said. Details of the terms were not available.
Work on the credit is proceeding separately from work on a $400 million Eurobond for the city, which is being lead-managed by CS First Boston and Nomura International, the sources said
The Eurobond is expected on March 15.
On Monday Moody's rated the Moscow Eurobond Ba2 and Standard and Poor's rated it BB-. Both ratings are the same as those allocated to Russian Federation's sovereign Eurobonds last year.
